planPhases.title: Create AuthContext (src/context/AuthContext.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created src/context/AuthContext.tsx. Initialises token/user from localStorage, exposes login() and logout(), exports AuthProvider and useAuthContext. All base tests still pass; auth test failures are from later phases (missing LoginPage/SignupPage).

planPhases.title: Create LoginPage (src/pages/LoginPage.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/LoginPage.tsx. Posts to http://localhost:3001/auth/login. On 200: calls login() and navigates to /. On 401/error: shows fixed string 'Invalid email or password'. Submit button is disabled while loading. All 4 authLogin.test.tsx tests pass. Build fails due to missing SignupPage (phase-3 pre-existing issue).

planPhases.title: Create SignupPage (src/pages/SignupPage.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/SignupPage.tsx. Posts to http://localhost:3001/auth/signup. Client-side password mismatch shows 'Passwords do not match' without calling fetch. On 201: calls login() and navigates to /. On 409: shows server's error.message. On 400 with details array: shows first details[0].message. Submit button disabled while loading. All 6 authSignup.test.tsx tests pass. Build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Update NavBar to show auth state
planPhases.notes: Updated src/components/NavBar.tsx to consume useAuthContext(). Logged out: shows Sign Up and Log In links. Logged in: shows username text and Log Out button that calls logout() and navigates to /login. Also added AuthProvider import and wrapper to App.tsx (minimal prerequisite so existing tests that render App still pass — routes left for phase-6). All 3 authNavBar tests pass; all 31 existing tests pass; build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Update productsApi to attach JWT header
planPhases.notes: Updated src/api/productsApi.ts to read localStorage.getItem('auth_token') before each fetch. If present, uses 'Bearer <token>'; if absent, falls back to 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024'. Both authProductsApiToken tests pass. Build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Wire AuthProvider and new routes in App.tsx
planPhases.notes: Added imports for LoginPage and SignupPage. Added <Route path='login' element={<LoginPage />}> and <Route path='signup' element={<SignupPage />}> as sibling routes outside AppLayout. AuthProvider was already wrapping the tree from phase-4. All 32 tests pass; build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run tests and verify all task12 visible tests pass
planPhases.notes: All 32 tests pass (10 test files): authProductsApiToken (2), authNavBar (3), app.render (1), loadingError (4), clearFilters (1), sorting (3), pagination (5), authLogin (4), filtering (3), authSignup (6). Build also succeeds with no TypeScript errors.
